network.title: Network interface
network.description: Choose which network connection Greenlight uses to connect to your Xbox.

modeDescription.nat: Use the operating system's default route. If a VPN is active, the stream may go through the VPN.
modeDescription.wifi: Connect only through the Wi-Fi adapter. Any active VPN is bypassed for the stream.
modeDescription.lan: Connect only through a wired Ethernet adapter. Any active VPN is bypassed for the stream.

network.restartRequired: Restart Greenlight to fully apply this setting (WebRTC needs to expose real local addresses).
network.missingInterface: No {{type}} connection with an IPv4 address was detected. Streams will fail until it is connected.
network.vpnDetectedNat: A VPN connection is active. In NAT mode the stream may be routed through it. Choose Wi-Fi or LAN to bypass it.
network.lastRouteOk: The stream used the selected connection.
network.lastRouteMismatch: The stream did not use the selected connection. Check the Wi-Fi / LAN connection and VPN settings.

controller.noController: No controller detected. Connect a controller and press any button.
controller.noRumble: This controller does not support vibration
controller.reconnectDescription: Not detected even though macOS shows it connected? This does a software unplug and replug of USB controllers. Press a button afterwards.
controller.reconnectDone: Reconnected {{devices}}. Press any button on the controller.
controller.reconnectNone: No USB game controller was found to reconnect.
controller.remapDescription: Click Remap and press the physical button you want to use. Press Escape to cancel. Remapping applies to controller input during streams.
controller.duplicateWarning: Some physical buttons are assigned to more than one Xbox button.

input.enableLegacyDescription: (Отключение этой функции отключит сопоставление клавиатуры с геймпадом и позволит управлять только с геймпада.)

streaming.title: Настройки трансляции
streaming.description: xHome и xCloud по умолчанию не поддерживают более 20 Мбит/с. Эта настройка не отменяет это ограничение.

videoAudio.streamResolutionDescription: (Higher resolutions need a fast connection. 1440p only works for cloud gaming on supported games; Remote Play to your own console is limited to 1080p. Takes effect on the next stream.)
videoAudio.frameRateDescription: (Caps the displayed frame rate to save battery and GPU. Greenlight also asks the server for this frame rate, but it may ignore the request, so data usage might not go down. Takes effect on the next stream.)
videoAudio.motionSmoothingDescription: (Experimental. Generates in-between frames when a game streams at 30 FPS, so motion looks smoother. Adds about 33 ms of input delay while active, and does nothing for 60 FPS games. Overrides the frame rate limit. While streaming: Ctrl+Shift+S toggles it, Ctrl+Shift+I shows live stats.)
videoAudio.forceLowResDescription: (Эта опция полезна на Steam Deck и позволяет приложению работать в низком разрешении, чтобы можно было включить FSR.)

myConsoles.streamingWarning: Потоковая передача с консоли не включена

streamWindow.errorConsoleOfflineHintPower: Make sure the console is turned on, or set to "Sleep" power mode so it can be woken remotely.

streamWindow.errorStreamFailedMessage: Something went wrong while starting the stream. Please try again.
